Transform

Apply an ANTs/ITK spatial transform to a TRX tractogram (point-warp). Rust counterpart to antsApplyTransformsToTRX.

THE OPPOSITE-NAMED H5 RULE: to warp streamlines FROM space A TO space B, pass from-B_to-A_xfm.h5 — the same file you would give antsApplyTransforms to warp an image of B onto A’s grid. (Same convention as antsApplyTransformsToPoints.)

CARTOON BIDS EXAMPLES — given sub-01’s paired h5 files:

• You have sub-01_space-ACPC_tracts.trx and want tracts in MNI152NLin2009cAsym → pass sub-01_from-MNI152NLin2009cAsym_to-ACPC_xfm.h5

• You have sub-01_space-MNI152NLin2009cAsym_tracts.trx and want tracts in ACPC → pass sub-01_from-ACPC_to-MNI152NLin2009cAsym_xfm.h5

• You have sub-01_space-T1w_tracts.trx and want tracts in MNI152NLin6Asym → pass sub-01_from-MNI152NLin6Asym_to-T1w_xfm.h5

WHY OPPOSITE-NAMED? Image warping with antsApplyTransforms is pull-based: the chain inside from-X_to-Y_xfm.h5 (the file that warps X-images onto a Y-grid) internally maps target Y voxels back to source X coordinates. Applied to a point, that same chain sends a Y-point to an X-point — so warping a vertex A→B requires the chain in the opposite-named file from-B_to-A_xfm.h5.

FULL INVOCATION (warp ACPC tracts into MNI): trxrs transform sub-01_space-ACPC_tracts.trx sub-01_space-MNI152NLin2009cAsym_tracts.trx –transform sub-01_from-MNI152NLin2009cAsym_to-ACPC_xfm.h5

Fields

§input: PathBuf

Source TRX file (e.g. sub-01_space-ACPC_tracts.trx).

§output: PathBuf

Output TRX path (e.g. sub-01_space-MNI152NLin2009cAsym_tracts.trx).

§transform: PathBuf

ANTs/ITK transform: Composite.h5 (warp + affines), Insight Transform File V1.0 (.txt, affine-only), or ITK MATLAB (.mat, affine-only — what ANTs writes for *0GenericAffine.mat). To warp tracts from space A to space B, pass from-B_to-A_xfm.h5 — the SAME file you would give antsApplyTransforms to warp an image of B onto A’s grid (see the description above for the rationale).

§reference: Option<PathBuf>

Reference NIfTI or TRX in the target space (the space the streamlines will land in). Optional; if given, the output TRX header’s voxel_to_rasmm and dimensions are taken from it (handy for downstream tooling that depends on the header). The streamline coordinates themselves are warped regardless.

§invert: bool

Numerically invert the chain before applying. Useful only for affine-only chains where you have one direction’s .txt/.mat and want the other; warp components cannot be numerically inverted (you must use the paired from-Y_to-X_xfm.h5 instead).

§overwrite: bool

Replace the output file if it exists.

§json: bool

Print summary as JSON.

CopyMetadata

Copy DPS / DPV / groups (and optionally DPG) from one TRX onto another.

The donor and target must describe the same streamlines (matching nb_streamlines and nb_vertices for the kinds being copied). When --output is omitted, the target is rewritten in place via a sibling temp file and atomic rename.

Fields

§target: PathBuf

Target TRX whose metadata will be augmented.

§from: PathBuf

Donor TRX whose metadata is read.

§output: Option<PathBuf>

Output path. If omitted, TARGET is rewritten in place.

§dps: Vec<String>

Copy only this DPS array (repeatable).

§dpv: Vec<String>

Copy only this DPV array (repeatable).

§groups: Vec<String>

Copy only this group (repeatable).

§copy_dpg: bool

Also copy data-per-group entries for the selected groups.

§overwrite_conflicting_metadata: bool

If a metadata key already exists on the target, replace it with the donor’s. Without this flag, name collisions abort the operation.

§skip_mismatched: bool

Skip donor arrays whose row count does not match the target instead of aborting.

§

Simplify

Fit each streamline to a sparse Catmull-Rom control polygon and write a TRX that’s ready to load directly in trxviz-draw (no further simplification on import).

The output gets a catmull_rom_fitted marker in header.extra plus default width (1.0 mm) and tension (0.5) DPV columns. By convention the output filename ends in .draw.trx; the default output path replaces the input’s extension with .draw.trx.

Fields

§input: PathBuf

Input TRX (or any format read_tractogram accepts).

§output: Option<PathBuf>

Output path. Defaults to <input-stem>.draw.trx next to the input.

§epsilon: f32

Hausdorff tolerance in RAS+ mm.

§group: Option<String>

If set, keep only streamlines belonging to this group.

§default_width: f32

Default width (mm) value written as a per-vertex DPV column.

§default_tension: f32

Default tension value written as a per-vertex DPV column.

§positions_dtype: PositionDtype

Positions dtype for the output TRX.

§

Subset

Extract a subset of streamlines from a TRX file.

Fields

§input: PathBuf
§output: Option<PathBuf>

Output TRX for the merged subset. Required unless –group-export is set.

§groups: Vec<String>

Include streamlines from this group (repeatable; result is their union).

§num_streamlines: Option<usize>

Keep only this many streamlines (applied after group filtering).

§selection_method: SelectionMethod

How to select when –num-streamlines is smaller than the candidate set.

§seed: Option<u64>

Random seed for reproducible random selection.

§group_export: Option<String>

Export each group to its own file. Use {groupname} as a placeholder, e.g. bundles/{groupname}.tck. Supports any output format. When combined with –group, only those named groups are exported.
